Select IC50 activities in nM against target CHEMBL203 (Epidermal growth factor receptor). Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', organism = 'Homo sapiens', non-null canonical_smiles, and at least one of pubmed_id or doi. Return DISTINCT rows for compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
